newsitem.title: USA: Telxon settles suit with Symbol Tech.
newsitem.headline: Telxon settles suit with Symbol Tech.

text.p: Telxon Corp said Tuesday it has settled the lawsuit it filed against Symbol Technologies Inc on September 4, in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio.
As part of the settlement, said Telxon, Symbol has agreed to clarify certain statements it made in earlier advertisements regarding the IEEE 802.11 standards for wireless networks.
Telxon said that with the settlement of this suit, it is confident that any confusion within the marketplace caused by Symbol's previous statements will be cleared up.
Symbol Technologies was not immediately available for comment.
Telxon Corporation is a designer and manufacturer of wireless and mobile transaction solution systems for vertical markets.
